home.title: Welcome to CX Chat
home.subtitle: A tiny, friendly place to start a conversation.
home.lead: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the coffee is still warm and the ideas keep flowing.
home.paragraph1: Every great chat begins with a simple hello. This page is just a playground for random thoughts, half-finished sentences, and the occasional brilliant idea that shows up unannounced.
home.paragraph2: Somewhere between the first message and the last, a whole story gets written. We keep it light, we keep it curious, and we always leave room for one more question.

chat.subtitle: Pretend messages, real vibes.
